Class Cursor

java.lang.Object
gate.sql.Cursor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Fetchable, AutoCloseable
public class Cursor extends Object implements AutoCloseable, Fetchable
Enables iteration over the results of a query.

    • getEntity

      public <T> T getEntity(PropertyGraph<T> graph, Function<String,Object> context) throws ConversionException
      Reads the current row as a java object of the specified type with its property values matched to their respective column values.

      The context may provide a value for a property, identified by its full name, before the cursor tries to read it from the current row. Returning null means the property should be resolved normally from the cursor.

      Parameters:
      graph - PropertyGraph of the entity to be read
      context - function used to provide contextual values for specific property names
      Returns:
      the current row as a java object of the specified type with its property values matched to their respective column values.
      Throws:
      ConversionException
